```yaml
name: Update uv.lock

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "pyproject.toml"
    branches:
      - main
      - master
      - develop
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "pyproject.toml"

jobs:
  update-lockfile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          version: "0.5.10"
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Check for anti-loop commit message
        id: check_message
        run: |
          COMMIT_MESSAGE="${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}"
          if [[ "$COMMIT_MESSAGE" == *"Update uv.lock"* ]]; then
            echo "skip=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Skip if anti-loop condition met
        if: env.skip == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Skipping due to anti-loop commit message"
          exit 0

      - name: Run uv lock
        run: |
          uv lock

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: "Update uv.lock"
          add: "uv.lock"
          push: true

      - name: Fail if lockfile is out of sync on PR
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "Error: uv.lock is out of sync with pyproject.toml"
          echo "Please run 'uv lock' locally and commit the changes."
          exit 1
```
